description: Log a perfume as worn (perfume of the day) on the user's own Parfumo account, now or at a past `date`, with an optional personal note. PUBLIC: the perfume worn shows on the member's public profile. Side effect: a perfume that is in none of the lists is added to 'Tested'. Not idempotent: each call logs one more wear. On this server publicly visible writes stay in dry-run mode unless the operator enabled them; the answer then shows the requests that would be made. Supports dry_run. Requires a linked Parfumo account.

comment.description: Personal note on this wear (255 characters at most).

date.description: When it was worn: "YYYY-MM-DD" or "YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM", not in the future. Default: now.

dry_run.description: When true, nothing is sent: the answer shows the requests that would be made.

perfume.description: Perfume worn: `id`, Parfumo URL or numeric `p_id`.

name: parfumo_log_wear

Wear.description: One logged wear ("perfume of the day").

comment.description: The member's own note on this wear.

perfume_id.description: Perfume identifier usable with every perfume tool (`Brand/Perfume`).

wear_id.description: Identifier of the wear, to pass to parfumo_delete_wear.

worn_at.description: Local date and time of the wear as shown by Parfumo (`YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM`).

WriteCall.description:
A write request to Parfumo, as built before being sent (also shown by `dry_run`).
The session `csrf_key` is added at send time and never appears here.

form.description: Form fields (`application/x-www-form-urlencoded`), without the CSRF token.

dry_run.description: True when nothing was sent to Parfumo.

executed.description: True when at least one write request was sent.

notes.description: Side effects and things to know.

planned_requests.description: The write requests sent, or that would be sent (CSRF token omitted).

public_writes_enabled.description: Whether this server is allowed to send publicly visible writes (operator setting).

wear.description: The wear as Parfumo lists it after the call.
